name: Process Street
summary: Recurring work as trackable checklists and SOPs, with approvals and conditional logic.
best_for: operations-driven teams that run recurring, checklist-based processes and want them tracked and auditable
skip_if: you just need to write down a few SOPs — a doc or a cheaper tool captures them without the platform cost
honest_knock: Pricing is opaque and jumps steeply from Startup to Pro, with seat minimums that push the real cost above the headline per-member rate — you'll need a sales call to price it. Best once recurring checklists are core to how you operate.

pricing.notes: Process Street publishes no prices. Re-verified 2026-08-17, 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-06: every tier on their pricing page, Startup included, shows Contact sales rather than a figure, and our monthly captures from July and August 2026 are byte-for-byte identical and contain no amount. What the page does publish are the limits. Startup is capped at 5 users and 10 guests, with 5,000 Data Set records, 10 automation apps, 100 automation actions a month and a public API limited to 50 calls a month. The page describes it as a simplified Pro plan for startups. Pro comes with a 14-day free trial that needs no credit card. Figures quoted elsewhere — roughly $100 a month for Startup, the $1,500 range for Pro, per-member rates around $12.50 to $15 — do not come from Process Street and we could not verify any of them. The FAQ on the same page adds one lever the plan cards do not show: discounts for registered non-profits, arranged through sales.

open_questions.question: Can you publish a price, or a starting price, for the plans that are quote-only?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
